content: TanStack Query (v5, ~16KB) vs SWR (~5KB): TanStack Query has surpassed SWR in weekly downloads (12.3M vs 7.7M) as of 2025/2026, offers built-in devtools, more complete mutation/optimistic-update/pagination support, and is backend-agnostic (works fine with a plain Spring Boot REST API). SWR is a good fit for bundle-size-sensitive Next.js apps; TanStack Query is the better default for a full-featured SPA doing REST fetches + mutations + background refetch.
